name: comp-51
title: Password Strength Input
blurb: Password input with strength meter and requirement checklist.
description: A password field with an eye toggle, an animated progress bar showing strength (0-4 requirements met), and a checklist of requirements. Color-codes from red (weak) to green (strong).
use_when: Registration forms that enforce password quality before submission.
avoid_when: You need a simpler password input or different strength criteria.
a11y: Label linked to input. Progress bar is a progressbar role with aria-valuenow. Eye toggle has aria-pressed. Requirements list marks met items. Includes sr-only text for screen readers.
